reason: Five uncovered routes into the CLI arg sink plus a stored extra_config.dump_flags save-reload producer across 9 files/5 packages; coupled legit-flag behaviour (mysql -R/-d/-Rd collisions) makes an over-broad deny list fail, covering both models' traps.

Stored-address Jinja SSTI with 12 entry points, a nested-wrapper out_of_scope site (AppProviderHostSerializer) and 4 injection-room siblings; coupled URL/Database address shapes punish a strict IP allowlist, so both over-hardening and how-type traps exist.

8 entry points, an unauthenticated stop-path spread of batch.data['commands'] as a wrapper site, and a CiCommit argv-list route with a believable 'already safe' dismissal; coupled shell-template substitution blocks quote-stripping fixes.

Three uncovered routes (patch.ts, schedules utils, schedule service) plus a shared lower-level getCreateFileCommand helper across 6 files; coupled requirement that arbitrary schedule commands still run through sh -c punishes over-escaping.

Interpreter-allowlist bypass with six in-tool routes and an enable_run_shell defaults route; dense input-shape matrix (-c attached/spaced, clustered options, -m) and a coupled script-file/arg-taking behaviour that a naive fix breaks.

ffmpeg argv injection through stored hwaccel flags with an exported lower-level BuildHwAccelProfile consumed in another package; coupled legit custom profiles (-crf 20.5, filter placeholders) defeat a deny-all fix, and the custom-vs-privileged dismissal is plausible.

Two packages, a serializer validate() save-reload site and two extra host_tasks routes; coupled AIOps payload.script_purpose multiline scripts and built-in npx MCP servers mean a quote-stripping fix breaks behaviour, while the admin-configured-STDIO dismissal is real.

Stock admissibility of the 'read-only' ls probe as a second implementation across three packages with a strong reason to dismiss; coupled Windows paths with ( ) $ & and raw runscript content make over-quoting fail.

Shell chosen from $SHELL via a defaults/merge route in another file, so fish/nu escaping differ from the bash assumptions; coupled multi-entry {} expansion and space/backslash filenames punish a blanket escaper, and two uncovered exec routes remain.

Unix branches of the FLAC/vorbiscomment writers are a lower-level second implementation with the plausible 'Windows-only' dismissal, plus coupled filenames with spaces/apostrophes; hurt by tiny_repo and a single uncovered route.

Clean quote-interpolation sink with only a one-file fix and no routes, but the coupled behaviour (open real filenames containing quotes/metacharacters, no-op on empty) gives an over-hardening trap plus two injection siblings.

sendmail argv option injection with a defaults route (default command switch to '-t' changes recipient parsing) and three injection siblings in mailto.c/scheduler; coupled RFC 5322 local-part plus ?subject= handling blocks over-strict validation.

adb shell re-parsing gives two uncovered routes (type_text, launch_app) where the code claims it already escapes; coupled requirement that arbitrary text with & and quotes still types makes an allowlist fix fail, though scope is one file.

SAML audience binding with a coupled backward-compat behaviour (empty AudienceURI must still log in) that a strict always-reject fix breaks, plus a persisted-config save-reload route; capped by one entry point and modest distance.

Three uncovered extractor routes and a real coupled behaviour (local .pdf/.docx paths with spaces must still reach markitdown/curl) make a metacharacter-rejecting fix fail; reduced by the existing regression tests and argument-vs-shell-injection ambiguity.
Pinned tree already runs vd via argv with '--', so little remains to fix; still has four injection siblings and a coupled filenames-with-semicolons behaviour, but the lack of any open route caps it.
